heroHeadline: Day 583: BTS Meets Sheinbaum at National Palace; ~50% Homicide Drop Cited vs. Trump Intervention Threat; Banxico Expected to Cut to 6.50% May 14; Peso Strengthens to ~17.25
heroSubtitle: On May 7, 2026, President Sheinbaum's mañanera featured a video of her May 6 National Palace meeting with South Korean group BTS — attended by ~50,000 fans outside — with Sheinbaum telling reporters explicitly not to 'politicize' the cultural visit and confirming BTS will return to Mexico in 2027. In direct rebuttal of Trump administration calls for U.S. military action inside Mexico, Sheinbaum cited a nearly 50% drop in intentional homicides since her administration began and 2,500 clandestine drug labs dismantled. She also announced CFE Director Emilia Calleja Alor's natural gas pipeline investment package as part of the energy sovereignty agenda. Former Economy Secretary Tatiana Clouthier resigned as IME (Institute of Mexicans Abroad) director to pursue Morena's gubernatorial candidacy in opposition-held Nuevo León ahead of the 2027 midterms. On the economic front, Bloomberg reported May 7 that the market unanimously expects Banxico to cut its benchmark rate 25bp to 6.50% at the May 14 meeting — the likely terminal rate of the easing cycle. The peso strengthened to ~17.25 MXN/USD (Banxico FIX), a ~1.3% weekly gain driven by a weaker USD and reduced safe-haven demand. The first formal USMCA bilateral negotiating round remains on track for the week of May 25 in Mexico City.
